LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASS: DETERMINERS: QUANTIFIERS:

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which words do we use to show amount or quantity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts
2. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASS: DETERMINERS: QUANTIFIERS:
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words do we use to show amount or quantity?
2. Why is it important to tell the quantity of something?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts
2. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
